segment.source: Simulate evolution with agents that search for food, reproduce and pass on mutating genes. Inspect individual agents and analyze population and gene distribution in charts.
segment.target: Oziq izlaydigan, ko‘payadigan va mutatsiyaga uchragan genlarni uzatadigan agentlar bilan evolyutsiyani simulyatsiya qiling. Alohida agentlarni ko‘rib, populyatsiya va genlar taqsimotini grafiklarda tahlil qiling.
